name: Dolhan Cricket
original_name: ドルハン・クリケット
source:
Dolhan Cricket is one of the last remaining Insect Users on the Continent and an obedient slave of [url=/c98806]Emi Alphorne[/url]. He is her personal servant, and though she treats him cruelly, he has long since been completely broken and serves her faithfully. 

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211119040518/https://alicesoft.fandom.com/wiki/Dolhan_Cricket]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
